content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-worked requirements for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your background against PMI standards before you enroll in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your Fort Walton Beach–area role. Upon completion, receive your formal course certificate, required to apply for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI using your training certificate and project-experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval of your application. This step formally qualifies you to sit for the PMP examination and confirms your credentials with the Project Management Institute.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to practice test questions and review core competencies. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center. Granite PM Academy's instructors remain available to clarify complex topics before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Engage in ongoing training, volunteer work, or formal education to meet PMI's maintenance requirement. Renew your certification before expiration to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
